description: Lutron Caseta lights, switches and fans over LEAP: status, on/off/dim, fan speed, scenes. Runs on Anima Sedes (forwards over ssh from elsewhere).

caseta.description: status [--json] | on <device> [level] | off <device> | toggle <device> | level <device> <0-100> | fan <device> <off|low|medium|medium-high|high> | scenes | scene <name>. <device> = id or words in its name; --all to act on several matches.

args.name: subcommand
args.description: status, on, off, toggle, level, fan, scenes, scene
Device (id or name words), then level / fan speed; --all, --json
